generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The size-mismatch validation is performed both before the loop (via `size()` comparison) and redundantly inside the loop (via `hasNext()` checks on the iterators). Since the upfront `size()` check guarantees the iterators will never be exhausted before the primary iterator, the in-loop checks are unreachable dead code. Removing them would simplify the logic and avoid the impression that a different failure mode is possible.
